history.overview: The Industrial Yard is the intake and staging area for all raw materials entering Muramite industrial production.

timeline.name: Yard Construction
timeline.description: Dragorn slaves built reinforced platforms and ore tracks.

timeline.name: Material Intake
timeline.description: Ore carts began delivering Discord-tainted stone from fissure mines.

timeline.name: Slag Dump Expansion
timeline.description: Arcane slag disposal pits were expanded due to contamination.

timeline.name: Industrial Integration
timeline.description: The Yard was linked to the Refinery and Foundry supply lines.
